name: @extas/combos
description: Combos and sets (S03 core, PR 89–104, 571, 575): the combo model with its pieces, set price, saving and active window (PR 89), the combo admin services (PR 90), auto colour-pair combos from a rule (PR 571, the owner's model), set tiers read from Smart Rules (PR 99), set validation (PR 101), the set summary with price and saving (PR 96), adding a set to the bag as one locked-price set (PR 97), the set photo composed from the piece photos (PR 575) and combo analytics (PR 104).
